title: Rioproperty header
description: A fixed, bare header: a very wide-tracked capital wordmark at the left (stacked on two lines on phones) and a three-line burger whose lines shorten downwards. It sits transparent over the hero, slides away once you scroll down and comes back on a paper background when you scroll up. The burger opens a full-screen violet panel of huge capital links that turn yellow on hover.
notes: made to overlay a dark full-bleed hero (overMedia); set overMedia false on light pages
the wordmark is plain text in the display face, letter-spaced 0.35em
